data.comment:
# Comfy Wan2.5- Text to Image

Generate images with excellent prompt following and visual quality using Wan 2.5. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_wan_text_to_image.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Backlighting, medium shot, sunset, soft light, silhouette, central composition, circular camera movement. The camera follows the character from behind to the front, showing a rugged cowboy gripping his holster tightly, his eyes alert as he patrols the desolate Western ghost town. The cowboy wears a worn brown leather jacket, with a bullet belt around his waist and the brim of his hat pulled low. His outline is sketched into a soft silhouette by the setting sun. Behind him are dilapidated wooden buildings with long-broken windows, glass shards scattered on the ground, and dust swirling in the wind. The camera slowly circles from his back to his front, with light pouring from behind, creating a strong dramatic contrast. The scene presents warm tones, enhancing the desolate atmosphere.
